synthesis.overnight_summary: Gold was flat to slightly firmer overnight. Spot dipped to $3,919.85 early in Asia, then recovered to ~$3,935-3,944 by 08:15 IST as early midterm counts showed Democrats ahead and the dollar slipped (DXY ~101.2-101.5 vs 101.87). Against that, CME FedWatch still prices ~79% odds of a December hike after the hawkish 10-2 October hold and strong JOLTS and ISM data. Brent eased to ~$103 on Iran/Hormuz deal talk, even as Iran called the US reply 'unconvincing' and the US struck Qeshm. The rupee opened 14 paise stronger at 94.61, which cancelled most of the small COMEX gain. The model fair open is ~139,510 vs the actual 139,408 open, so the open was aligned and tradeable, with the election result as the swing factor for the day. synthesis.open_plan: Open signal is aligned_tradeable (deviation ~-100 vs a 300 threshold), so no wait is required. Pre-open plan: treat 138,070-140,620 as the first-hour range.
